summary.zh: 盘点软件与供应商开支，找出可削减项
summary.en: Audit SaaS and supplier spend, cut duplication and speed up buying.

description.zh: 梳理软件订阅和供应商开支，找出重复、闲置和可合并的采购项，分析采购周期为何漫长。适合年度降本、续约谈判或采购流程明显拖沓时使用。
description.en: Reviews SaaS and supplier spend, surfaces duplicate, idle and consolidatable purchases, and explains why buying cycles drag. Useful for cost-cutting rounds, renewal talks and slow procurement.
